# YakuBus / Yakushima Bus / 屋久島バス / 屋久岛公交

> Independent trilingual transport tool for Yakushima, Kagoshima, Japan. Not the bus or ferry operator.

## Pages

- [Yakushima Bus Timetable 2026: Next Bus & Fares | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/): Find your next Yakushima bus, timetables, routes and fares with YakuBus. Plan port, airport and trailhead connections, explore the island map, and find ferry booking links and travel guides. Independent free tool based on official sources.
- [Yakushima Bus Fares 2026: Route Map & Day Passes | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/fare/): View official Yakushima bus route maps and fare PDFs. Select stops for adult one-way fare estimates, day pass information and suspended-route notices. Fare-table revisions are separate from timetable revisions.
- [Yakushima Ferry Tickets | Kagoshima Jetfoil Booking & Offers](https://yakushimabus.com/ferry/): Book Kagoshima–Yakushima Toppy/Rocket tickets on Klook, check offer terms or use HIS. Independent guide to official timetable and fare references, Miyanoura/Anbo ports and bus connections. Confirm same-day sailings with the operator.
- [Yakushima Island Map: Attractions, Hot Springs & Bus Stops | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/map/): Explore Yakushima hot springs, beaches, historic sites, supermarkets, pharmacies, ATMs and bus stops. Read place descriptions, open navigation and follow links to bus timetables. Check road notices for mountain destinations.
- [Yakushima Tours: Guided Hikes, Snorkeling & Day Trips | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/trekking/): Also explore sea turtle snorkeling and guided forest walks. Compare Viator and Klook Yakushima tours, forest walks, Tachudake treks, stays and Kagoshima day trips. See tour reviews separately from Tripadvisor operator reviews, with official road notices and bus connections.
- [Yakushima without a car: plan two nights and three days | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/without-car/): Plan two nights on Yakushima without a car. Check port-to-airport buses, the return from Shiratani Unsuikyo and the transfer for Arakawa Trailhead.
- [About YakuBus: Yakushima Transport Sources & Contact](https://yakushimabus.com/about/): YakuBus is an independent Yakushima bus, fare and ferry information site. Find official operator PDFs, tourism association sources and contact details. Planned timetables and temporary service suspensions are recorded separately.
- [Miyanoura or Anbo? Choose a base without a car | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/yakushima-where-to-stay/): Compare your arrival port, early starts and dinner arrangements before choosing a hotel. An area name alone does not tell you how easy a stay will be.
- [Rain in Yakushima: alternatives and changing plans | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/yakushima-rainy-day/): Check the roads, transport and activity location first. Keep one indoor option or a plan near your accommodation instead of filling every day.
- [A half-day in Kagoshima before or after Yakushima | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/kagoshima-half-day/): Stay by the waterfront or choose one city sight. Work out your usable time after luggage, travel and boarding formalities before deciding how far to go.
- [Yakushima & Kagoshima Travel Guides | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/): Practical Yakushima and Kagoshima guides: plan a car-free stay, choose a base, prepare for rain and use a half-day around your ferry journey. Official references and transport tools.

## Data scope and dates

Timetable revision: 2026-10-01; fare revision: 2024-03-01; checked 2026-11-03; review due 2026-11-17. Recheck official information before travel.
All times use Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+9). Choose the actual travel day and check each conditional service note.
The internal display horizon is a conservative review policy, not an official PDF expiry date.
The bus homepage / is Japanese; use /?lang=zh or /?lang=en for Chinese or English. The legacy /?lang=ja URL resolves to /. Other pages retain their ?lang=ja, ?lang=zh and ?lang=en URLs.

## Recorded service notices — recheck before travel

These are dated source records, not live confirmation. An overdue review does not establish that a suspended route has reopened.

- Some town roads close for bridge inspections Oct 16–28, including access toward Senpiro Falls. Check the official notice for each location, date and detour. Checked 2026-10-26; review due 2026-11-02; notice scope 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-28. Source: https://yakukan.jp/topics/19545.html
- Shiratani has partially reopened: Taiko-iwa, the moss forest and Bugyosugi routes are accessible. Taneyaku buses have resumed. Parts of the Yayoi-sugi course and other sections remain closed. Checked 2026-11-03; review due 2026-11-17; notice scope 2026-10-18 to until further notice. Source: https://y-rekumori.com/
- Matsubanda’s Shiratani timetable still shows suspension. This is a different operator from the reopened Taneyaku service and does not mean every Matsubanda route is suspended. Checked 2026-11-03; review due 2026-11-17; notice scope 2026-10-24 to until further notice. Source: https://yakushima.co.jp/route_bus/
